Āhlādana
third son of Devacandra, younger brother of Ambaḍa Mantrin. At his instance Vardhamānasūri wrote his Vāsupūjyacaritra, in Saṁ. 1299 which bears consequently the ‘Āhlādana-aṅka’ (

stotra. on Devī in 104 verses. by Jānī Mahāpātra, son of Jānī Jayadeva an. pupil of Paṇḍitarāya Jagannātha. Written in A.
. Bikaner 2976-8 (2976 inc.). Rep. Raj & C. I. p. 49. See J. G. Jha. Inst. IV. iii-iv. p.. 225-7.
